jobgether-jobgether:lever:1c4e801e-91fb-.title: Scientific Director - Oncology (Medical Communications)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1c4e801e-91fb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Scientific Director - Oncology (Medical Communications) based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead the scientific strategy and content development for medical communications programs within oncology. You will partner with senior scientific leaders and clients to translate complex clinical data into accurate, compelling, and strategically relevant communications. The position combines scientific expertise with project leadership, editorial oversight, and client collaboration. You will independently guide content development across multiple formats and audiences while ensuring scientific rigor and compliance with professional standards. The role also includes mentoring junior scientific team members and coordinating internal and external contributors. It is well suited to an experienced medical communications professional who thrives in a flexible, collaborative, and intellectually rigorous environment. Partner with senior scientific leadership to develop strategic medical communication recommendations that support client objectives and brand goals across oncology programs. Lead the planning, development, and scientific oversight of content for assigned accounts, adapting materials to different audiences and communication needs. Independently manage content development activities, including background research, scientific writing, data checking, reference annotation, and editorial review. Develop and oversee promotional medical education materials such as advisory board content, speaker programs, slide decks, and related scientific communications. Analyze and interpret scientific and clinical data to ensure content is accurate, evidence-based, clinically relevant, and aligned with communication objectives. Supervise and mentor Associate Scientific Directors and collaborate with internal teams, freelance writers, editors, and other contributors to coordinate content development. Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining high-quality deliverables and meeting demanding timelines with limited direction. Apply established medical editorial standards, including AMA style, as well as relevant ethical and industry guidelines throughout the content development process. Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve scientific, editorial, and project-related challenges while maintaining accuracy, transparency, and scientific value. Requirements Advanced degree in a scientific or medical discipline is required. 5+ years of relevant professional experience in medical communications, with demonstrated experience developing promotional medical education content. Proven experience creating and overseeing materials such as advisory board programs, speaker programs, slide decks, and other medical education deliverables. Demonstrated oncology experience is required, with strong preference for expertise in solid tumors, particularly lung cancers. Strong ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex scientific and clinical data accurately and effectively. Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and consistently meet tight deadlines. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate with clients, scientific leaders, writers, editors, and cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, exercise sound scientific judgment, and manage responsibilities with limited supervision. Familiarity with professional medical editorial practices, including AMA style, as well as applicable ethical and industry guidelines. Experience supervising, mentoring, or providing scientific direction to other team members is highly valuable. Benefits Flexible, primarily remote work environment designed to support work-life balance. Opportunity to contribute to high-impact medical communications programs acros

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:a6bb467b-659e-4996.title: Electrical Engineer – Power Distribution
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:a6bb467b-659e-4996.description: Electrical Engineer – Power Distribution Location: Marietta, OH Job Type: Direct Hire Position Overview We are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the design, testing, certification, and ongoing improvement of power distribution equipment. This role combines electrical design, hands-on troubleshooting, documentation, and product support.
responsibilities: Design electrical systems at the product level, including component selection, thermal design, mechanical packaging support, and interconnection hardware.
Apply knowledge of analog and digital circuits, magnetics, and thermal systems.
Develop engineering specifications for power protection systems.
Design switchboard power and control circuits.
Create and maintain BOMs, schematics, and other engineering documentation.
Support integration and qualification of third-party devices in power distribution equipment.
Participate in hardware design reviews and product robustness evaluations.
Prepare customer and manufacturing documentation, test procedures, and technical reports.
Provide sustaining engineering support for new and existing power protection systems.
Perform hands-on troubleshooting of electrical systems and subsystems.
Support product safety certifications and work with NRTL organizations to meet UL, CSA, and IEC requirements.
qualifications: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE).
Experience with AutoCAD or similar CAD drafting software.
Experience designing power distribution equipment such as PDUs, STSs, RPPs, and switchboards.
Familiarity with electrical engineering test equipment, including oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and signal generators.
Knowledge of three-phase electrical systems and power systems.
Strong technical writing, documentation, and communication skills.
Strong laboratory, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

viessmann-viessmann:ashbyhq:87e8149d-03b.title: Manager Group Accounting (m/f/d)
viessmann-viessmann:ashbyhq:87e8149d-03b.description: Build the future of group finance - and grow into systems, consolidation, and portfolio exposure. This role is designed as a long-term development platform within Group Finance at Viessmann Generations Group, supported by close collaboration with the CFO and senior stakeholders. It is an opportunity for high-potential professionals to transition from audit or accounting into a dynamic holding environment and develop a broad, future-oriented finance skill set. You will work at the core of financial transparency, gaining exposure to group accounting, reporting structures, and financial systems across a diverse international portfolio. Starting from a strong accounting foundation, you will progressively expand your scope into consolidation, systems, and cross-entity collaboration. VIESSMANN GENERATIONS GROUP OVERVIEW As a globally active, independent family business in its fourth generation, we have been shaping living spaces for generations to come since 1917. Under the leadership of Max Viessmann, we pursue our mission with a long-term perspective and entrepreneurial spirit. Today, the Viessmann Generations Group supports over 30 mid-sized companies and family businesses across Europe and the US – all united by their active contribution to the energy transition. We invest capital, expertise, and passion in three core impact areas: - Climate: Renewable energy, carbon reduction, and green infrastructure - Water: Solutions for water scarcity, quality, and efficiency - Food: Sustainable agriculture, supply chain innovation, and food technology Our goal: to create impact – ecological, societal, and entrepreneurial. The Viessmann Way https://www.viessmann.group/how/the-viessmann-way supports how we work, lead, and create value together - whether as a team member, entrepreneur or partner in our ecosystem. It is not a rulebook, but a compass: a living set of principles shaped by over a century of entrepreneurship and guided by our long-term purpose. THE OPPORTUNITY You will be part of the Group Accounting function and contribute to building transparent, reliable, and scalable financial structures across a growing portfolio of companies. The role combines solid accounting work with increasing exposure to systems, reporting logic, and portfolio collaboration. A key element of the role is to develop a strong understanding of how group finance operates in a modern holding structure - including how responsibilities shift towards portfolio companies and how systems enable scalable reporting. Over time, you will have the opportunity to expand your scope into tool development, process improvement and standardization, and potential project exposure within portfolio companies. KEY CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES Group Accounting & Financial Foundations - Support the preparation and review of financial statements and reporting packages - Ensure accuracy, consistency, and transparency of financial data - Maintain a solid understanding of accounting principles and financial flows Selective Consolidation & Reporting Support - Support consolidation processes at group level, particularly for key reporting cycles - Maintain and further develop existing consolidation structures and logic - Ensure data quality and consistency across entities Systems & Process Exposure - Work with and further develop financial systems (e.g. consolidation and ERP environments) - Support the definition of requirements and improvements in reporting and data structures - Contribute to reducing manual processes and improving efficiency Portfolio & Stakeholder Interaction - Collaborate with portfolio companies to ensure high-quality data and reporting alignment - Support the gradual shift of responsibilities toward portfolio entities - Build strong working relationships across finance teams YOUR PROFILE - Top-tier academic background from a leading university in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field - Proven experience in Audit at a Big4 firm or compara

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:9f8cba61-d8b.title: Slovenian SEO Specialist
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:9f8cba61-d8b.description: About Adapt Adapt, a Welo Global brand, is an international digital performance marketing agency focused on driving the success of digital content across platforms and markets. We offer our customers a unique combination of global services designed to support their growth from strategy all the way through to execution, production, and performance measurement. With a collaborative and inclusive environment, you will join a unique culture which celebrates difference and embraces diversity. You will play a key role in developing strong relationships and shared ethos, whilst at the same time benefiting from a wide range of career opportunities, training, and flexibility for work-life balance. Our culture is built on curiosity, and we are looking for team members who have a passion for learning about the developments in the industry, their clients, and their peers. In return, we offer the opportunity to develop your ability and exposure to a wide range of clients from growth-minded startups all the way up to global enterprise clients. Our client base is predominantly focused on B2B businesses, though we do also support customers in the e-commerce and retail space. Regardless of vertical, Adapt offers dynamic and diverse challenges that foster creativity, innovation and application of knowledge to create client solutions. MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB We are seeking a freelance SEO Specialist to join and support our SEO team. In this role, you will play a key part in enhancing our SEO efforts by conducting keyword research, utilizing keyword planners, and optimizing content, among other responsibilities. MAIN DUTIES The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role: - Keyword Research - Keyword Planner - Metadata Optimisation - Content Optimisation - On-Page Optimisation - Keyword Translation from English to Slovenian and Slovenian to English - Data Handling and Management - SEO Copywriting REQUIREMENTS Education Level Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a college or university in a related field, or equivalent work experience. Experience A minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in SEO. Strong working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript for SEO, with basic skills in writing and reading code. In-depth understanding of best practices for various search engines, including Google, Bing, Baidu, and others. Proven ability to deliver successful results through SEO initiatives. Extensive knowledge and experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics, SiteCatalyst, and WebTrends. Advanced proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. Expertise in using third-party SEO analysis tools, including Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Majestic, and similar platforms. Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines consistently. Strong understanding of how other online and offline marketing channels—such as display ads, affiliates, social media, print, TV, and email—interact with and influence SEO. Please note that successful candidates will need to have an Office 365 License installed into their devices to be able to complete the tasks assigned.
